pages.text: $(li)$(item)Chemical vat$(): breaking the controller drops its items, and a vat absorbed when you build a bigger one hands its items and fluids over instead of losing them.

$(li)$(item)Arc furnace$(): JEI now shows that coal coke dust is a $(item)catalyst$() that returns to the vat input, with only about 10% used per batch. This was the cause of the "nothing is produced" reports.

$(li)$(item)Blast furnace$(): the hatch keeps its items, and the furnace saves its fuel and gives it back when broken.$(li)$(item)Casting basin$(): take the cast ingot out $(item)with an empty hand$(), no funnel needed.

$(li)$(item)Flamethrower$(): only fuel that really leaves a tank is credited, so it can no longer refuel for free from an engine.$(li)$(item)Piping upgrade$(): never voids fuel any more and moves only what the engine accepts.$(li)$(item)Large engine$(): the goggles now explain why it is idle.

$(l)New recipes$()$(li)A $(item)Magnet by hand$(): a magnetic alloy ingot, 3 redstone blocks and a compass, for the first magnet before you own a polarizer.$(li)$(item)Aluminium from a superheated mixer$(): 4 bauxite powder and 1 coal coke dust give an aluminium ingot, to get started before electrolysis.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
